changelog: Golden Mic v1.4.8 — Mic permission now asks again on every tap until allowed; round Power button (Ear Spy Pro style); Gain left / Volume right; Booster card in place with correct text; compact Equalizer above Monitor; Monitor then Advanced Settings; home-screen text overlap fixed; admin panel auto-removes devices not seen for 30 days and shows ONLINE for active devices; panel gate check once per 24 hours. Rescue features unchanged.
